summary: Frontend-only delta retest of iter106am follow-up: TrainerAvatar.tsx now gates its per-avatar pulse Animated.loop on AppState (matching AccentGlowOverlay + FloatingOrangeBg patterns). Validated single-file diff via codebase review, ESLint, Metro bundler logs, asset/require parity from iter106, and backend smoke. Clean pass — no regressions.

validation_performed.TrainerAvatar_AppState_gating: Confirmed L19 imports useState; L20 imports AppState from react-native; L50 pulseAnim ref unchanged; L57 useState(paused) initialized from `AppState.currentState !== 'active'` (correct inverted form — paused=true when NOT active); L58-63 effect subscribes to AppState 'change' and sets paused=(next !== 'active') with proper cleanup via sub.remove(); L65-75 pulse-loop effect now early-returns when (!pulse || paused) and lists [pulse, paused, pulseAnim] as deps so the loop tears down on background and recreates on foreground. ESLint clean. Halo <Animated.View> still renders unconditionally when pulse=true (L82) — its Animated.Value freezes at last interpolated value while paused, which is fine off-screen.
validation_performed.metro_bundler: Expo Metro dev-server logs show repeated successful `Web Bundled ... node_modules/expo-router/entry.js (730 modules)` lines after the TrainerAvatar diff. Zero 'Unable to resolve module' errors, zero red errors, zero TypeScript errors. Only persistent log noise is ngrok tunnel timeouts (pre-existing env limitation, not a regression).
validation_performed.iter106_assets_intact: ls confirms bg-spin-class.jpg (93KB), bg-battle-ropes.jpg (98KB), bg-box-jumps.jpg (87KB) all present. Grep across /app/frontend/app and /app/frontend/src returns ZERO matches for bg-(spin-class|battle-ropes|box-jumps).png and EXACTLY 22 matches for the .jpg variants — same count iter106 reported, so no require() references were lost or changed.
validation_performed.iter106_overlays_intact: Grep confirms AccentGlowOverlay.tsx still has AppState import + useState(appActive) + subscriber + loop-pause via pulse.stopAnimation when !appActive, and effect deps [pulse, appActive]. FloatingOrangeBg.tsx still has AppState import + useState(paused) initialized from `AppState.currentState !== 'active'` + 'change' subscriber + Ember `paused` prop with effect deps [paused]. Both files unchanged in this iteration.
validation_performed.web_preview_gate: Per iter106 context, web preview serves stale /app/frontend/dist/ ('Welcome to Expo' placeholder) — documented pod limitation, not a regression. Metro Web bundles do build successfully (730 modules) showing the source tree compiles.

critical_code_review_comments: TrainerAvatar.tsx L82 — the halo <Animated.View> is still rendered whenever `pulse===true`, even while paused. The Animated.Value freezes at its last interpolated opacity/scale on background. Minor: consider also gating the render with `{pulse && !paused && <Animated.View ... />}` to fully drop the halo node from the tree when backgrounded, which would shave a few RN view nodes per dense list. Cosmetic only — current behavior is safe.

TrainerAvatar.tsx L65-75 — when paused flips true->false on resume, the loop is recreated from scratch but `pulseAnim` retains its frozen value. The first cycle will start the timing from that frozen value rather than 0, causing a brief asymmetric first pulse. Same nit raised in iter106 for FloatingOrangeBg embers; cosmetic only. Optional fix: `pulseAnim.setValue(0)` before `loop.start()`.

TrainerAvatar.tsx L57 — initializing useState lazily via `AppState.currentState !== 'active'` is fine, but consider `useState(() => AppState.currentState !== 'active')` if AppState.currentState evaluation ever becomes expensive (it isn't today on RN, just a getter). Style nit only.

Carryover from iter106 (still valid): AccentGlowOverlay's comment at L47-49 still claims 'Reset to a stable mid-value' but no `pulse.setValue(...)` call exists — misleading comment, cosmetic only. Not touched in this iter.

rca of the issue: No bug. Delta correctly addresses the iter106 testing-agent code-review note ('Consider passing pulse={false} on dense list/map views OR gating pulse with AppState the same way AccentGlowOverlay and FloatingOrangeBg now do'). Main agent chose the AppState route, which is the broader fix because (a) it doesn't require per-call-site prop changes across NearbyTrainers/Discovery/Saved/chat, and (b) every TrainerAvatar pulse loop now tears down on background, removing JS-thread reconciliation work when iOS resumes a long-suspended app. Combined with iter106's expo-image migration (image RAM) + JPEG re-encoding (decoded-image RAM) + AccentGlowOverlay/FloatingOrangeBg AppState gating (ambient loop CPU), all named contributors to the iOS jetsam WatchdogTermination are addressed.
